Sun Yat-sen was a Chinese revolutionary leader who played a key role in overthrowing the Qing Dynasty. The Xinhai Revolution of 1911 led to the abdication of the last emperor, Puyi, in 1912, ending approximately 2000 years of imperial rule in China and establishing the Republic of China.

Agent 1's answer of "Japan" is clearly incorrect. Japan maintained its imperial system and never had a republic established by Sun Yat-sen. Japan's emperor was not overthrown.

Agents 2, 3, and 4 all correctly identified China, with very high confidence levels (0.98, 1.00, and 0.98 respectively).
